author: Inside Edition
description: Jeff Webb was known as the “father of modern cheerleading,” and served as a mentor to the late right wing activist Charlie Kirk. Earlier this year, the 76-year-old founder of the cheerleading company Varsity Spirit was playing pickleball when he suffered a freak accident: he fell and hit his head. The fall resulted in what would be a life-ending injury. Webb was placed on life support for approximately two weeks before his family made the decision to remove him. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has more.
title: Charlie Kirk's Mentor Dies In Pickleball Accident

author: Inside Edition
description: A tearful Savannah Guthrie had her first interview since her mother's abduction. Guthrie sat down with friend and colleague Hoda Kotb, who has been filling in for her on the "Today" show. It has been 53 days since Nancy Guthrie was abducted from her home in Tucson. Surveillance video of the masked intruder at her door and thousands of tips later, the haunting case remains unsolved. On Wednesday, Savannah renewed her plea for help.
title: Savannah Guthrie Opens Up In 1st Interview Since Mother's Abduction

author: Inside Edition
description: Arielle Konig took to the stand in her husband Gerhardt Konig's attempted murder trial after he allegedly tried to throw her off a cliff in Hawaii. Arielle testified Gerhardt grabbed her and pushed her towards the edge. She said as she and her husband struggled, he pulled out a syringe but she was able to swat it away. She says he hit her with a rock after she screamed for help. Gerhardt has pleaded not guilty to attempted murder. He is claiming self-defense saying his wife attacked him first.
title: Wife Testifies At Trial Of Husband Accused Of Attempting To Murder Her

author: Inside Edition
description: Canceled Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul is reportedly still going to be paid her entire salary. The exact amount is unknown but former Bachelorettes have received up to $100,000 for the three-month gig. ABC pulled the plug on the season after video surfaced of her attacking her ex-boyfriend. Meanwhile, Zendaya stunned at the Paris premiere of her new wedding-themed rom-com "The Drama." The 29-year-old actress dazzled in a white long-sleeved Louis Vuitton gown.
title: Canceled Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul Will Still Get Paid: Reports

author: Inside Edition
description: Amy McGorry has had a lengthy career in front of a camera, reporting on news and events for her community in New York. It's a dream she says she's had to work hard and make sacrifices for. While she put on a brave face for the viewers watching her, Amy says she was silently suffering for years with autoimmune diseases, now she needs a liver transplant to save her life. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: News Anchor Who Needs Liver Transplant Makes Tearful Plea For Living Donor

author: Inside Edition
description: The disgraced TV star has been ordered to pay victim Donna Motsinger over $59 million in damages, stemming from the 1972 incident that occurred in northern California.
title: Bill Cosby Loses Sex Assault Lawsuit In California #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Strangers are stepping in to help another aged DoorDash delivery person. Larry Phillip Colvin is a 76-year-old Vietnam vet living in Texas. Faced with his wife's and son's mounting healthcare bills, the retired repairman “un-retired,” and started delivering for DoorDash. When a kind neighbor learned about Colvin's family's situation, she started a GoFundMe to help them. Inside Edition's Alison Hall has more.
title: Strangers Help 76-Year-Old Vietnam Vet Who Was Delivering For DoorDash

author: Inside Edition
description: The accident at New York's LaGuardia Airport killed the pilot and co-pilot, and injured dozens of people.
title: How Did Air Canada Flight Attendant Survive Airport Crash? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: One 70-year-old woman said she looked more like she was 90 so she went to Beverly Hills plastic surgeon Dr. Carl Truesdale for a facelift and CO2 laser treatment. The dramatic before and after results are lighting up social media. "It feels so good.I'm so happy," the woman says. "I feel like I'm 40. I tell everyone I'm 40 now." With her story going viral, other women have expressed curiosity about turning back time. Dr. Truesdale also gave his own mother a facelift.
title: 70-Year-Old's Before And After Facelift Goes Viral

author: Inside Edition
description: ABC is not responding to speculation Behar left the set because she didn't want to share the stage with country star and "American Idol" judge Carrie Underwood.
title: Why Was Joy Behar Missing From 'The View' After Commercial Break?
